app.name: Velunivo
app.subtitle: Your route. Your riding speed.
app.localizedDescription: Plan and navigate e-scooter and e-bike rides on a fullscreen map. Compare bicycle and car-road alternatives with configurable vehicle limits and locally learned pace after three qualifying rides. Save and rename places, save routes, record rides, export GPX, and plan again between recorded endpoints. Apple Maps on iPhone/iPad and key-free OpenFreeMap on Android/web. Native GPS/compass guidance includes spoken turns, speed, known road limits, arrival time, time remaining and distance remaining. Optional iOS Live Activities need a registered widget extension; active-ride GPS updates continue while locked with background location permission. The OS controls delivery; force-quitting stops guidance. Configure Stadia Maps in Settings for limited native offline region downloads; new routes still need the network. Public Photon/Valhalla services provide default address lookup and routing with fair-use limits. Optional transit/traffic previews never change ETA; scheduled trips do not predict traffic. Scooter access and battery estimates are unverified. JSON export and simulation are available in hidden Developer Mode. Simulated rides include spoken guidance and registered iOS Live Activities but are never recorded.
